description: Main entry point and root widget for a Flutter-based restaurant mobile application. It initializes core services, sets up dependency injection with providers, and defines the app's primary structure including routes, theme, localization, and global overlays.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Root widget of the Flutter app, manages app initialization, theming, localization, and navigational structure.

classes.name: _MyAppState
classes.description: State class for MyApp, manages async initialization, error handling, and build process.

classes.name: _InitOverlay
classes.description: A widget displaying a loading overlay during app startup.

classes.name: _InitErrorOverlay
classes.description: A widget displaying errors encountered during app startup and providing a retry mechanism.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the application; performs initial setup and runs the root widget.

methods.name: MyApp.createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the root widget.

methods.name: _MyAppState.initState
methods.description: Initializes state, starting the bootstrap process asynchronously.

methods.name: _MyAppState._bootstrap
methods.description: Performs async initialization tasks such as loading caches and preparing app data.

methods.name: _MyAppState.build
methods.description: Builds the MaterialApp widget with routes, theme, localization, and overlays.

methods.name: _InitOverlay.build
methods.description: Builds a semi-transparent overlay with a progress indicator and message.

methods.name: _InitErrorOverlay.build
methods.description: Builds an overlay indicating an error with an option to retry.
